733100201.text: Is this how they look like now? How pitiful.

733100202.text: Sorush, what are you talking about?

733100203.text: Never mind. I just happened to witness the undignified states of my kind, but it's no matter.

733100204.text: You see, that makes Paimon even more curious!

733100205.text: Let Paimon have a look... Oh wow, that really is one strange tree! The way it's shaped like a circle looks almost like a door, right?

733100208.text: Hehe, Paimon definitely would like to go first!

733100209.text: ...The Fravashi Trees are no doors. You'll disturb the residual Pari residing within if you simply barge through them.

733100210.text: So that's called a Fravashi Tree, huh? But where are the residual Pari... Paimon can't see them at all!

733100211.text: Of course Pale Floater can't see them. They are still trapped by obsessions of the past, after all.

733100212.text: It may not be what they wished for, but looking at the sight of them clinging desperately to this world... I can hardly bear this scene.

733100213.text: Looks pretty lush to Paimon. Doesn't it look nice?

733100214.text: Hmph, as if you understand the situation, Pale Floater. These Fravashi Trees are Pari that fought till the very end against the defilement that had been corrupting the land. Using the last remnants of their power, they transformed into this state that you see now.

733100215.text: They exhausted their strength, to the point where they could no longer maintain their form, and were rejected by the Vourukasha Oasis for being tainted.

733100216.text: Legend has it that in ancient times, the Order of Skeptics would hold a ritual of purification for them, so as to bring them all back to the Vourukasha Oasis.

733100217.text: But nowadays, there remains no one in the Order of Skeptics who is able to perform such a ritual. The best they can do is but to keep these Fravashi Trees alive.

733100218.text: But this only prolongs their suffering. Judging by their current appearance, they seem to have nothing left but the bitter memories they have to endure alone.

733100301.text: Hmph, is this how they look like now? How pathetic.

733100302.text: Sorush, what are you talking about?

733100303.text: Never mind. I just happened to witness the undignified states of my kind. No matter, we shall keep going.

733100304.text: You see, that makes Paimon even more curious!

733100305.text: Let Paimon have a look... Oh wow, that really is one strange tree! The way it's shaped like a circle looks almost like a door, right?

733100308.text: Hehe, Paimon definitely would like to go first!

733100309.text: ...The Fravashi Trees are no doors. You'll disturb the residual Pari residing within if you simply barge through them.

733100310.text: So that's called a Fravashi Tree, huh? But where are the residual Pari... Paimon can't see them at all!

733100311.text: Of course Pale Floater can't see them. They are still trapped by obsessions of the past, after all.

733100312.text: It may not be what they wished for, but looking at the sight of them clinging desperately to this world... How absurd and pathetic.

733100313.text: They may look a little strange, but calling them pathetic is just mean!

733100314.text: And looking at you being surrounded by so many plants, Paimon actually thought you'd feel at home.

733100315.text: Hmph, I only feel at home when I'm on a battlefield. Only the battle lasting until the end of time can be perceived as true eternity!

733100316.text: Now that you're following me, you'd better grasp that as early as possible, Pale Floater.

733100317.text: These Fravashi Trees are Pari that fought till the very end against the defilement that had been corrupting the land. Using the last remnants of their power, they transformed into this state that you see now.

733100318.text: They exhausted their strength, to the point where they could no longer maintain their form, and were rejected by the Vourukasha Oasis for being tainted.

733100319.text: Legend has it that in ancient times, the Order of Skeptics would hold a ritual of purification for them, so as to bring them all back to the Vourukasha Oasis.

733100320.text: But nowadays, there remains no one in the Order of Skeptics who is able to perform such a ritual. The best they can do is but to keep these Fravashi Trees alive.

733100321.text: But this only prolongs their suffering. Judging by their current appearance, they seem to have nothing left but the bitter memories they have to endure alone.

733100322.text: In a way, they have also fulfilled their mission. But it was all a meaningless act compared to a true sacrifice.

subQuests.subQuestName: Let Sorush awaken the residual Pari in the Fravashi Tree
Talk to the residual Pari in the Fravashi Tree

733100501.text: Ah, finally, at long last... Bring me the stamens of that flower. You know what I'm talking about, right?

733100502.text: I don't know how to face them if I return without any Udumbara. You're my only hope now!

subQuests.subQuestName: Bring the Udumbara to the residual Pari

733100601.text: Well, did you bring me the Udumbara Pistils?

subQuests.subQuestName: Talk to the residual Pari in the Fravashi Tree

733100701.text: Hehe, finally! I extend my gratitude.

733109904.text: It's a Fravashi Tree. We can't just leave it be!
